verifications.claim: Artemis II is NASA’s 10-day crewed flight test.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Scheduled for almost 10 days'; R3: 'The approximately 10-day Artemis II mission'; R5: 'Duration: 10 days'; R6: '10-day mission'; R7: '9 days, 1 hour, 32 minutes'; R9: 'The 10-day Artemis II mission'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly describe Artemis II as a ~10-day crewed test flight/mission.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is scheduled to launch no earlier than September 2025.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'This discovery directly led to the delay of Artemis II’s launch, which was previously scheduled for no earlier than September 2025.'
verifications.reasoning: R1 directly states the schedule as NET September 2025 due to delay; other sources describe subsequent delays but do not contradict this historical scheduling.

verifications.claim: Artemis II will send four astronauts around the Moon and back.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Four astronauts... on a trip around the moon'; R2: 'lifting four astronauts... around the moon but not land there'; R3: 'four astronauts... around the Moon'; R5: 'carrying four astronauts on a journey around the Moon'
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources consistently confirm four astronauts on a lunar flyby mission around the Moon and back.

verifications.claim: Artemis II marks the first human mission to lunar vicinity since 1972.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'first trip astronauts will take outside Earth orbit since 1972'; R2: 'last time astronauts traveled that far was Apollo 17, in December 1972'; R3: 'first crewed deep-space flight in over 50 years'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state it is the first crewed mission to lunar vicinity/deep space since Apollo 17 in 1972.

verifications.claim: Artemis II tests the Orion spacecraft.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Artemis I tested... Orion... Now, Artemis II is set to send humans'; R3: 'test flight'; R5: 'test the capabilities of the Orion spacecraft'; R6: 'test flight of... the Orion spacecraft'
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe Artemis II as a crewed test flight specifically validating Orion spacecraft systems.

verifications.claim: Artemis II tests the SLS rocket
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Artemis I tested out... SLS... and Orion'; R3: 'NASA’s Artemis II SLS rocket'; R5: 'NASA’s Space Launch System (SLS) rocket'; R7: 'second flight of the Space Launch System (SLS)'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm Artemis II as the second SLS flight, testing the rocket with crew.
